description: This file defines a CLI command 'qr' for generating a mobile pairing QR code and setup code, including configuration loading, secret resolution, and QR code rendering.

methods.name: renderQrAscii
methods.description: Generates an ASCII QR code from data using the qrcode-terminal library.

methods.name: readDevicePairPublicUrlFromConfig
methods.description: Reads the device-pair public URL from the loaded configuration.

methods.name: shouldResolveLocalGatewayPasswordSecret
methods.description: Determines if the local gateway password secret should be resolved based on config and environment.

methods.name: resolveLocalGatewayPasswordSecretIfNeeded
methods.description: Resolves and sets the gateway password secret in the configuration if needed.

methods.name: emitQrSecretResolveDiagnostics
methods.description: Outputs diagnostics messages related to secret resolution, either to stderr or stdout.

methods.name: registerQrCli
methods.description: Registers the 'qr' command in the CLI program, handling QR code generation and output.
